questions.question: The ________ is the worlds most widely used method of reversible birth control. Choose the correct option to fill the blank.
questions.explanation: Option (D) is correct: Intra Uterine Devices (IUD's).

questions.question: Choose the right one among the statements given below:
options: IUDs are generally inserted by the user herself.
IUDs increase phagocytosis reaction in the uterus.
IUDs once inserted need not to be replaced.
questions.explanation: Option (B) is correct: IUDs increase phagocytosis reaction in the uterus..

questions.question: The central Drug Research Institute (CDRI) is located at:

questions.question: Identify the false statements regarding the techniques of contraception and choose the correct option. I. There are many side effects of tubectomy and vasectomy. II. Contraceptive oral pills help in birth control by preventing ovulation.
questions.explanation: Option (C) is correct: I and II.
